title: 5.2 Deficiency Diseases
description: Deficiency diseases caused by lack of vitamins, minerals, and other nutrients

questions.question: What is a deficiency disease?
options: A disease that occurs when a person does not have enough of one particular nutrient and suffers health problems as a result
A disease caused by a pathogen such as a virus or bacteria
A disease that is inherited from parents
A disease caused by physical injury
questions.answer: A disease that occurs when a person does not have enough of one particular nutrient and suffers health problems as a result

questions.question: Which deficiency disease is caused by a lack of vitamin C?
What are the main symptoms of scurvy?
options: Bleeding under the skin, bleeding gums, and poor healing of wounds
Dry skin and swelling of the abdomen
Thin arms and legs with little muscle
questions.answer: Bleeding under the skin, bleeding gums, and poor healing of wounds

questions.question: Which vitamin deficiency causes rickets?
What is a characteristic symptom of rickets?
options: Deformed or soft bones in the legs of children
questions.answer: Deformed or soft bones in the legs of children

questions.question: Which vitamin can the human body produce when the skin is exposed to sunlight?
Beriberi is caused by a deficiency of which vitamin?
Pellagra is caused by a deficiency of which vitamin?
Night blindness is caused by a deficiency of which vitamin?
Anemia is a deficiency disease caused by a lack of which mineral?
What are the symptoms of anemia?
Goiter is caused by a deficiency of which mineral?
Kwashiorkor is a deficiency disease caused by a lack of which nutrient?
Which of the following is a symptom of kwashiorkor?
options: Swelling of the legs and abdomen, dry or flaky skin, and changes in hair colour
Thin arms and legs with an old-looking face
Bleeding gums and poor wound healing
questions.answer: Swelling of the legs and abdomen, dry or flaky skin, and changes in hair colour

questions.question: Marasmus is caused by a deficiency of which nutrient?
What are the physical signs of marasmus?
options: Thin arms and legs, little muscle, and an old-looking face
questions.answer: Thin arms and legs, little muscle, and an old-looking face

questions.question: What is malnutrition?
options: The insufficient, excessive, or imbalanced consumption of nutrients that leads to health problems
Only the lack of protein in the diet
A disease caused by bacterial infection
questions.answer: The insufficient, excessive, or imbalanced consumption of nutrients that leads to health problems

questions.question: Which of the following is a form of undernutrition?
Stunting in children is defined as:
options: Low height-for-age due to chronic undernutrition
Low weight-for-height due to recent weight loss
questions.answer: Low height-for-age due to chronic undernutrition

questions.question: What is obesity?
options: A condition caused by an imbalance between energy intake and energy expenditure, resulting in excess body fat
A disease caused by lack of protein
A condition caused by vitamin deficiency
A disease caused by bacterial infection
questions.answer: A condition caused by an imbalance between energy intake and energy expenditure, resulting in excess body fat

questions.question: A person with a BMI greater than 30 is classified as:
Which of the following is a health risk associated with obesity?
options: Heart disease, high blood pressure, and diabetes
questions.answer: Heart disease, high blood pressure, and diabetes

questions.question: Which food is a rich source of iron and can help prevent anemia?
options: Red meat, liver, and Tikur teff
questions.answer: Red meat, liver, and Tikur teff
